CustomField.description: FundFirst ships an 8-value default set; FQS relies on the In-Kind Recognition value to auto-generate self-recognition soft credits on In-Kind gifts. If any FQS-added value is missing post-install, restore via Setup.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why this party gets credit for a gift they didn't legally give — e.g., Solicitor moved the donor, Household Member is the donor's partner or family, Matched Donor is the matching employer, Honoree is the tribute recipient.
